bodybuildr: infographic pages built from blocks

bodybuildr-package.Rd

bodybuildr lays out PDF pages as trees of *blocks*. A block knows how tall it is at a given width and how to draw itself from the top-left corner of the space it is given. Blocks compose vertically with [bb_stack()] and horizontally with [bb_cols()], and a [bb_page()] places them between a header and a footer pinned to the bottom margin. [export_pdf()] writes one or many pages to a single PDF.

Details

Spacing comes in three separate bands, never mixed: 1. **Page margins** from [page_template()]. Blocks marked `full_bleed` escape the side margins. 2. **Layout gaps**: the `gap` of [bb_stack()] and [bb_cols()]. 3. **Box spacing**: padding and margin of [bb_box()] / [box_style()].

Geometry accepts `grid::unit` objects or plain numbers, which are read as inches. Colours accept any R colour or the name of a theme colour (see [bb_theme()]).
